mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8% over a 6-month horizon signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE exceeds 8% for 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 falls > 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 8% combined with a 3-month decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% signals severe labor market stress, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% AND PAYEMS falls > 1% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 8% AND PAYEMS falls > 1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% signals weakening economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls > 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the housing price index (HOUST) exceeding 4% signals a late-cycle housing boom, which increases household leverage and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST rises > 4% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% combined with a 3-month decline in housing prices (HOUST) exceeding 2% signals broad demand contraction, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > 2% AND HOUST falls > 2% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 falls > 2% AND HOUST falls > 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
